name: What types of bathtubs are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of bathtubs are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several common types of bathtubs suitable for various bathroom designs and needs. Alcove tubs are the most common, designed to fit into a three-wall enclosure. Drop-in tubs are installed within a framed enclosure, often tiled. Freestanding tubs offer a sculptural focal point, standing alone without surrounding walls. Walk-in tubs provide easier access for individuals with mobility challenges. Jetted tubs include air or water jets for a therapeutic experience. Each type has specific installation requirements and aesthetic considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathtub types include alcove, drop-in, freestanding, walk-in, and jetted tubs, each with unique installation and design features.
